description: Medicare plan comparison card for search results. Shows plan type badge, bold plan name, monthly premium, star rating, max out-of-pocket, benefits summary, optional pharmacy note, and a details link. Use one per plan returned by search_medicare_plans — never use Card+Badge+Text for plan comparison results.

example.benefits: Dental, vision, hearing. $0 primary care copay.

propDescriptions.planName: Full plan name, e.g. 'Pioneer Advantage Choice (PPO)'
propDescriptions.planType: Plan type badge: HMO, PPO, PFFS, SNP, etc.
propDescriptions.starRating: Star rating string, e.g. '4.5 stars' or '5.0 stars'
propDescriptions.benefits: One-sentence summary of key included benefits
propDescriptions.detailsHref: URL to plan details or medicare.gov plan-compare
propDescriptions.detailsLabel: Link label; defaults to 'View plan details'

description: Medicare knowledge summary panel with numbered key-point bullets. Use for search_medicare_knowledge answers to present key takeaways — replaces SummaryBox+Card composition. Pass facts as a pipe-separated string.

example.heading: Quick summary
example.facts: Original Medicare = Part A (hospital) + Part B (medical) from the federal government.|Medicare Advantage = Part C, a private Medicare-approved plan that bundles Part A and Part B.|Part D = prescription drug coverage, added separately or included in Medicare Advantage.

propDescriptions.heading: Panel heading, e.g. 'Quick summary' or 'Key points'
propDescriptions.facts: Pipe-separated key points, e.g. 'Fact one.|Fact two.|Fact three.' — use | as the delimiter, not commas or arrays

description: Medicare current-enrollment plan summary. Shows plan type header, bold plan name, Part A/B coverage start dates, cost summary (premium/deductible/coinsurance/out-of-pocket max), and a details link. Use for displaying a beneficiary's existing enrolled plan — not for search result comparison (use MedicarePlanCard for that).

example.planName:
Hospital Insurance (Part A)
Medical Insurance (Part B)

propDescriptions.planType: Plan category label, e.g. 'Original Medicare' or 'Medicare Advantage'
propDescriptions.planName: Full plan name; newline characters render as line breaks
propDescriptions.partACoverageDate: Part A coverage start date, e.g. '8/12/2019'
propDescriptions.partBCoverageDate: Part B coverage start date, e.g. '8/12/2019'
propDescriptions.detailsHref: URL for the coverage details link

description: VA appointment summary card. Shows provider, facility, date/time, type badge, and status. Use for VA appointment display.
VA claim status timeline. Shows 5-step progress (Received → Review → Evidence → Rating → Decision) with current step highlighted. Use for VA claim status display.
GI Bill / benefit entitlement summary panel. Shows program, total/used/remaining entitlement, expiration, and current enrollment. Use for GI Bill or benefit display.
VA facility locator card. Shows facility name, type badge, address, phone, distance, and hours. Use for VA facility display.

example.address: 3710 SW US Veterans Hospital Rd, Portland, OR 97239

propDescriptions.waitTime: Average wait time, e.g. '12 days average'
